Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body:
Which minion is being referred to in the Consignment to Duat text, "If this acting minion enters combat or is no longer ready..."

Is that he minion that receives the Consignment or the one who put it on?

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
"this acting minion" means the minion putting the Consignment on the target.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> "this acting minion" means the minion putting the Consignment on the target.
>
Correct.
